strings: r_c0 goes on a den visit to check in on m_c. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} been blankly staring at the den wall for most of the afternoon.
m_c comes into the medicine den, looking barely able to carry {PRONOUN/m_c/self} on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws.
m_c's Clanmates bring {PRONOUN/m_c/object} a little bit of extra prey and bedding while {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/lie/lies} in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest, weighed down and exhausted.
Part of {PRONOUN/m_c/object} wishes it were raining, as m_c likes the sound, which is like a lullaby to take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} away from the deep-seated exhaustion in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} bones.
m_c feels barely able to do {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} in-camp jobs this moon.
